_comment: Shared schema for gml_to_ifc.py. Edit this file to change CityGML-type -> IFC-class mapping, the Pset name, or attribute IFC types - no code changes needed. The GML tag list that gets extracted (which fields exist at all) stays hardcoded in gml_to_ifc.py (SIMPLE_ATTR_TAGS/CODE_ATTR_TAGS) since it's tied to the parsing logic itself.

cityfurniture._comment: Keyed by 'class|function' coded-value pair, as they appear on frn:CityFurniture (see github.com/3CIM/3CIM2.0 CityFurniture_class.xml / CityFurniture_function.xml). Anything not listed here falls through to 'default' below.

transport._comment: Keyed by the original CityGML element tag (tran:Track/Road/TrafficArea), carried through as the 'citygmlClass' attribute.

Track.note: CityGML 2.0 tran:Track = foot/cycle/horse path, not rail - mapped same as Road

default._comment: Used whenever a CityObject's type/class/function doesn't match anything above. The original CityGML type is always kept as a 'citygmlType' Pset attribute so it stays traceable.

_ifc_schema_overrides_comment: Base keys (ifc_class, optional ifc_object_type -> IfcObject.ObjectType) describe IFC 4.3 (IFC4X3_ADD2). Any mapping entry may add 'ifc_schema_overrides': { '<schema>': {...} } with the keys that differ when running with --ifc-version 4 (schema 'IFC4'), which has no IfcRoad/IfcPavement/IfcFacility. Every entry is validated against every supported schema at load time. Which classes aggregate into IfcSite (IfcFacility subtypes) vs are contained in it is read from the IFC schema itself, not configured here.

attributes._pset_name_comment: Must NOT start with 'Pset_' - buildingSMART reserves that prefix for its own standard property sets.
